request.detail: Completed fetch/XHR Resource Timing only; observation time includes delivery delay. Requests started before recording may appear. Failed, unfinished, worker and non-fetch/XHR requests may be absent. Cross-origin detailed timing requires Timing-Allow-Origin. URLs omit credentials, queries and fragments; paths remain.

query.detail: Supplied QueryCache add/remove/update notifications; no pre-existing snapshot, mutation cache, payloads or inferred request links. Query hashes are bounded but may contain key values.

react.detail: Supported development React root commits; hook must precede React. renderDurationMs is root actualDuration when positive, otherwise unknown; not commit wall time, native UI timing, effects or component attribution. No Fiber tree traversal.

navigation.detail: No TanStack Router supplied; other routers and native navigation are not observed.
